rv.q: And so it proves with “Darling,” a poignant comic study of the bad faith and bad behavior of a narcissistic celebrity and those around him.
This doomed and ridiculous bid for authenticity is at the heart of Kenneth Lonergan’s amusing and uneven Hold on to Me Darling at the Atlantic Theater Company.
But with Timothy Olyphant (Justified) anchoring a pitch-perfect cast, and with Lonergan’s absolutely uproarious script, it’s the farthest thing from tragedy.
